entities.name: Cambridge Learning Center
entities.relation_to_jahongir: Founder-linked organization repeatedly associated with Jahongir Pulatov in public sources
facts: According to the official site, it has operated since 2014.
According to the official English landing page, it presents itself as having 11+ years of experience as of March 2026.
According to the official site, it has served 100,000+ learners.
According to the official site, it has 14 branches across Uzbekistan.
According to the official site, it has 500+ employees.
According to the official site, it highlights IELTS outcomes up to 9.0.
According to the official site, it offers experienced teachers, test center access, free events, co-working zones, and a Be Student program connected to Central Asian University.
According to the Russian landing page, free student activities can include tennis, golf, mafia, cinema, celebrity meetups, and trips.
According to the official site, its certificates are recognized by 15+ companies and 10+ universities.
According to the official Cambridge Students' app page, the center positions the app as part of a hybrid-learning model with a personal student cabinet.

The official App Store listing says Cambridge Student App lets students earn points, see a leaderboard, and work with online lessons and materials, and the listing is published under developer Jakhongir Pulatov.
As of March 15, 2026, the official Cambridge site publicly lists the main contact number as +998 78 777 77 74.
As of March 15, 2026, the official public offer lists the legal entity as CAMBRIDGE GROUP LLC with legal address Tashkent city, Chilonzor district, Olmazor massivi, 6/7, and telephone 78 777 77 74.
As of March 15, 2026, official branch pages publicly list branches in Sergeli, Inyaz, Drujba 1, Drujba 2, Darxon, Tinchlik, Yunusobod, Novza, Ferghana, and Samarkand.
As of March 15, 2026, the official English branch listing publicly shows branches such as Sergeli, Inyaz, Drujba 1, Drujba 2, Darxon, Tinchlik, Yunusobod, Novza, Ferghana, and Samarkand.
A public Telegram post says Cambridge started from three small rooms near Xalqlar do'stligi and was built to give English learners modern conditions and quality education.
A LinkedIn Cambridge job post says the organization publicly presented itself as Brand of the Year 2019-2020 and winner of the HR Brand of 2022 award.
A LinkedIn Cambridge company post says top teachers can earn a special trip to London, which supports the public signal of a strong performance-and-incentive culture.
faq_like_details: Placement test required for new students.
General English and IELTS-focused programs are highlighted.
The English pages describe General English as 5 levels, each lasting 3 months, with classes 3 times per week for 80 minutes.
The English pages highlight Sunday activities like Movie Day, Speaking Club, debates, and seminars with guest speakers.
A cashback condition is advertised for IELTS Level 2 and IELTS Rocket students who score 7.5+ overall and present the certificate.
Official offer language defines a Cambridge points and Cambridge coin reward system inside the Cambridge Students' app.
The official registration page says classes are conducted offline in Tashkent, Fergana, and Samarkand.
As of March 15, 2026, the public pages used here do not show a fixed public course price list for Cambridge, so exact tuition amounts should not be invented.

entities.name: Jahon School
entities.relation_to_jahongir: Official site names Jahongir Po'latov as founder
facts: According to the official site, Jahon School is a project from Cambridge LC.
Official homepage snippets present Jahongir Po'latov as founder of Cambridge LC, Modme, Cambridge Kidzzz, and Jahon School.
According to the official about page, Jahongir Po'latov brings 14 years of experience in education into general school education.
According to the official site, the mission is to unlock student potential, develop social skills, and raise students with exemplary behavior.
According to the official site, it is a technological school using LMS, gamification, and dedicated apps for teachers, students, and parents.
According to the official site, the school draws on Japanese and South Korean educational achievements.
According to the official site, it includes an 11-year SkillDev life-skills program.
According to the official founder message, Jahon School sees high-quality education as the main solution to deep social problems.
According to the official about page, the long-term vision is to spread its authorial program for skills, knowledge, and behavior to all regions of Uzbekistan by 2030.
According to the official about page, the school publicly emphasizes values around innovation, responsibility, belonging, and tolerance.

According to the official about page, the school presents a wider ecosystem with partner signals like Safia, Najot Ta'lim IT clubs, Akfa Medline health support, Turin engineering and robotics exposure, Qamar Books, and Cambridge's English expertise.
The App Store developer page under Jakhongir Pulatov lists JS O'quvchi and JS Ota-ona, which is a strong public signal that Jahon School also operates its own student and parent app ecosystem.
As of March 15, 2026, official Jahon School pages publicly list the main contact number as +998 78 777 07 07.
As of March 15, 2026, official Jahon School pages publicly list the school location as Tashkent city, Olmazor district, Beruniy street, 83, near Tinchlik metro station.
As of March 15, 2026, the public pages used here explain payment structure and discounts but do not show a fixed public tuition amount.
admissions_and_operations: Admissions steps listed: school visit, school introduction, parent interview, psychologist interview, measuring academic level, final admission.
FAQ says there is no dormitory.
FAQ says payments can be split every 6 months or monthly.
FAQ says annual fees change at most once per year.
FAQ says students receive three meals a day.
Official FAQ says an early admissions-season discount of 15% was publicly announced through June 1, 2025, but that specific discount should be treated as dated rather than assumed current.
FAQ says parents get app-based monthly updates on attendance, academic performance, mood, mental state, and health.
Official pages show a consultation/contact flow for parents who want to learn more before admission.
The JS O'quvchi App Store listing describes timetable, homework, progress, grades, menu, and rewards/shop as core student-app functions.

entities.name: Modme
entities.relation_to_jahongir: Official about page names Jahongir Pulatov as founder and CEO
facts: According to the official site, Modme is software for education centers.
According to the official site, it provides CRM and LMS-style capabilities.
Public feature descriptions include lead management, registration, scheduling, finance, reporting, grading, reminders, integrations, and remote management.
According to the official site, it also offers student and teacher mobile apps, cloud-based access, and financial reporting.
According to the official homepage, Modme offers a free demo period of up to 7 days.
Dealroom says Modme launched in 2020 and reached break-even in 2021.
Dealroom says Modme served 330+ training centers in Uzbekistan by early 2023 and had started expanding into Indonesia.
Dealroom says Modme raised $100,000 from UzVC in February 2023 at a $1.2 million valuation.
Dealroom says Modme later launched a white-labeled mobile application for education centers in 2024.
The official vacancies page shows a sales model focused on presenting Modme CRM to education centers and running B2B sales conversations.
The official resources and offer pages explicitly frame Modme as a service for legal entities and entrepreneurs rather than consumer use.
As of March 15, 2026, the official prices page publicly lists four tiers: Start for 0-100 students, Basic for 100-300, Pro for 300-1000, and Premium for 1000+ students.
As of March 15, 2026, the official contacts and resources pages publicly list Modme's phone number as +998 (78) 777-11-00.
As of March 15, 2026, the official resources pages publicly list the legal address as Tashkent city, Mirzo-Ulugbek district, Navnihol mahalla, Tepamasjid street, 4A.
faq_like_details: As of March 15, 2026, the official prices page advertises a 9-month payment bonus of 1 month and a 12-month payment bonus of 2 months.
The official gamification page lists a separate monthly module price of 150,000 so'm and frames it around coins, levels, rewards, and branded engagement.
The official support page offers video lessons, documentation, Telegram support, and a demo request path.
The official site also offers a free demo request.

entities.name: Selfmade
entities.relation_to_jahongir: Publicly associated with Jahongir Pulatov in semi-official sources
facts: IT Park conference materials identified Jahongir Pulatov as founder of Selfmade.
Yosh Tadbirkor University described Selfmade as a youth entrepreneur community founded by Jahongir Pulatov.

entities.name: Cambridge Kidzzz
entities.relation_to_jahongir: Official Jahon School site groups it among Jahongir Po'latov's education projects
facts: Jahon School official pages group Cambridge Kidzzz together with Cambridge LC, Modme, and Jahon School as part of Jahongir Po'latov's education ecosystem.
This supports the view that Cambridge Kidzzz is one of the education brands publicly linked to Jahongir Po'latov.

entities.name: Get Coffee
entities.relation_to_jahongir: Publicly associated with Jahongir Pulatov in event listings and promotional posts
facts: A Fermerlar Maktabi event post identified Jahongir Pulatov as founder of Get Coffee.
MFaktor promotional posts tied Get Coffee vouchers and giveaways to Jahongir Pulatov's public appearances, which supports the public association between him and the brand.

entities.name: Hope
entities.relation_to_jahongir: Publicly associated with Jahongir Pulatov in event listings
facts: A Fermerlar Maktabi event post identified Jahongir Pulatov as founder of the Hope charity foundation.

Public secondary descriptions repeatedly group Hope with Cambridge, Modme, and Get Coffee as part of Jahongir Pulatov's wider project ecosystem, but detailed public operating information remains limited.
